summary.storyTitle: Story 5: Minimal Structural Views Over Turns
summary.implementedScope: Implemented Story 5 end-to-end by adding durable derived-archive-view storage functions, a deterministic derived-view service over rebuilt turns, authenticated list/refresh archive routes, archive-page client loading/rendering for structural views, and Story 5 server/client/Convex coverage for ready, degraded, stale-rebuild, and conflict flows.
summary.acceptanceRationale: Story-lead scoped acceptance is ready for impl-lead review and outer acceptance.

evidence: convex/derivedArchiveViews.ts exposes api-key-checked service wrappers and internal raw storage handlers; platform-store routes server calls through wrappers; archiveEntries tests prove shared key enforcement.

tests/service/client/derived-archive-views.test.ts now builds degraded derived views through DefaultTurnDerivationService and DefaultDerivedArchiveViewService.listViews, while asserting canonical archive rows remain available.

changedFiles.reason: Added durable replace/list Convex functions and validation for structural derived archive view rows.
Implemented deterministic turn_range and chunk_candidate generation, degraded-state propagation, and refresh conflict detection.
Wired the new derived archive view service into app construction and Fastify decorations.
Added authenticated derived-view list and refresh API routes under the process archive path.
Extended archive surface state to carry derived archive views.
Initialized derived-view state on the archive surface.
Added browser API helpers for listing and refreshing derived archive views with archive-specific error handling.
Loaded derived archive views alongside archive entries and turns on archive-route bootstrap.
Added the client rendering surface for structural derived views, provenance, boundaries, and degraded states.
Embedded the derived archive views section into the archive page.
Updated derived-view fixtures to use deterministic structural labels and explicit turn ranges.
Added durable-row coverage proving derived view creation does not alter canonical archive entries.
Added refresh-conflict API coverage for ARCHIVE_DERIVATION_CONFLICT.
Added Story 5 server coverage for structural views, provenance, stale rebuilds, and archive-readable failure behavior.
Updated archive page test state to include derived-view data.
Updated archive page test state to include derived-view data.
Added client coverage for ready/degraded derived-view rendering on the archive page.
